concept.core: All Janus-produced or user-provided audio can pass through one stable pyramid-derived acoustic operator while semantic content changes.
concept.json_record: Canonical JSON can be turned into a deterministic audible record analogous to a data-derived record/playback artifact.
concept.microphone: The same operator can act as an explicit-start local voice changer for microphone input.
concept.habitat: The Voice of Janus is registered as a typed reference/handoff edge in Git Habitat.

operators.json: JSON -> CANONICAL_UTF8 -> NIBBLE_TONE_RECORD -> PYRAMID_MODAL_OPERATOR -> WAV + RECEIPT
operators.head: DEMIHEAD -> INLINE_TYPED_JSON_REQUEST -> VOICE -> JSON_RECORD_WAV + RECEIPT

json_record_v0_2.symbol_mapping: each byte -> two nibbles -> 16-tone alphabet derived from pyramid modal frequencies

microphone_mode.implementation: optional local sounddevice front end over shared stateful modal filter

symbolic_provenance.meaning: conversation provenance marker for Pyramid Language concept

next_gate: Observe exact-head CI in Voice and DemiHead; freeze a real cross-repository inline JSON request/receipt fixture; then build a reversible FSK/ECC data-carrier decoder and separately validate real-time microphone latency before promoting live voice changer beyond candidate status.
